incidents.name: Wiener DOGE transfer burn without pair sync
incidents.notes: The WDOGE token's _transfer() deducts a burn/fee from the PancakeSwap pair's own balance without calling sync(), so the attacker could repeatedly transfer in, skim() the resulting surplus and swap out the pair's WBNB.

sources.ref: onchain review: WDOGE 0x46bA8a59f4863Bd20a066Fd985B163235425B5F9 created 2021-06-03T02:12:43Z by 0x7e03eddc5a3fe778b4eb2a333728f3fa45d30933, unrelated to attack sender 0x962f8b446de3e524cf99042149ebecc0130bcdbf; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Loss verified onchain: 78.66 WBNB left the WDOGE/WBNB pair to the attack contract in the exploit transaction, comfortably above the $1,000 floor at April 2022 BNB prices. Loss converted: 78.6584 WBNB x $384.40 at incidentTimestamp 1650875635 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $30,236.
